responsibility: This header declares the public token-buffer interface used by the mc lexer, parsers, and diagnostics. It exports the current-token globals, procedures for opening and closing sources, resetting or replaying the buffered token stream across passes, inserting tokens, querying token numbers and source positions, mapping token numbers back to line/column/file information, retrieving associated comments, and adding lexer-produced tokens and file-stack events.
same_name_distinction: This .h file is the public interface companion to GmcLexBuf.cc: it exposes the current-token globals and declarations for source opening, pass reset/replay, token insertion, and source-location lookup without defining the underlying bucket/list machinery.
